dimensions.name: is_weekend_label
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: age_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN age < 18 THEN 'Under 18'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 54 THEN '35-54'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 55 AND 74 THEN '55-74'
  ELSE '75+'
END
